interpretation_limits: Owned TiDB process counters include background work and observer boundary overhead.
Delta per success uses acknowledged logical successes, not attributed query allocations.
Different source capture windows must remain visible when comparing normalized counters.
Go allocation counters describe TiDB Go process activity, not Rust owned allocations.
Metrics with different names can describe overlapping events; do not add aliases.
Histogram or summary count fields are events; no durations, pause time, or latency are inferred.
Executor expensive_total fields count executor events and do not measure executor duration.
Missing optional metrics are null, never zero; all required metrics must have complete series.
No physical I/O, lock contention, CPU saturation, or causal allocation claim follows from these counters.
